'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = ["HourLabel", "HourIdx", "Segment", "Cluster", "Minutes"]
df["HourIdx"] = df["HourIdx"].astype(int)
df["Minutes"] = df["Minutes"].fillna(0.0)
df = df[df["Minutes"] > 0]

SEG_COLORS = {"hydration": "#e76f51", "foil": "#e9c46a", "schubert": "#2a9d8f",
              "manual": "#636e72", "unattributed": "#b2bec3",
              "web": "#3B82F6", "sealing": "#F59E0B", "handling": "#8B5CF6",
              "pneumatic": "#10B981"}
SEG_ORDER = {"hydration": 0, "foil": 1, "schubert": 2, "web": 0, "sealing": 1,
             "handling": 2, "pneumatic": 3, "manual": 10, "unattributed": 11}

def hex_blend(hexcolor, ratio):
    r = int(hexcolor[1:3], 16); g = int(hexcolor[3:5], 16); b = int(hexcolor[5:7], 16)
    if ratio >= 0:
        r = int(r + (255 - r) * ratio); g = int(g + (255 - g) * ratio); b = int(b + (255 - b) * ratio)
    else:
        f = 1 + ratio; r = int(r * f); g = int(g * f); b = int(b * f)
    return "#%02x%02x%02x" % (max(0, min(255, r)), max(0, min(255, g)), max(0, min(255, b)))

hours = df[["HourIdx", "HourLabel"]].drop_duplicates().sort_values("HourIdx")
hour_idx_list = list(hours["HourIdx"])
hour_labels = list(hours["HourLabel"])
n_hours = len(hour_idx_list)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(46.8, 18.0), dpi=300)

if n_hours == 0:
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No hourly data for this selection", ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=39, color="#636e72")
else:
    totals = df.groupby(["Segment", "Cluster"])["Minutes"].sum().reset_index()
    shade_map = {}
    legend_entries = []
    for seg, seg_df in totals.groupby("Segment"):
        seg_df = seg_df.sort_values("Minutes", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
        base_color = SEG_COLORS.get(seg, "#b2bec3")
        n = len(seg_df)
        for i, r in seg_df.iterrows():
            shade = hex_blend(base_color, (i * 0.5 / max(n - 1, 1)) if n > 1 else 0.0)
            shade_map[(seg, r["Cluster"])] = shade
            legend_entries.append((seg, r["Cluster"], shade, r["Minutes"]))
    legend_entries.sort(key=lambda t: (SEG_ORDER.get(t[0], 5), -t[3]))

    x = list(range(n_hours))
    for xi, hidx in zip(x, hour_idx_list):
        hdf = df[df["HourIdx"] == hidx]
        total_min = hdf["Minutes"].sum()
        running = max(0.0, 60.0 - total_min)
        bottom = 0.0
        ax.bar(xi, running, bottom=bottom, width=0.72, color="#f0f1f5", zorder=2)
        bottom += running
        segs_here = sorted(hdf["Segment"].unique(), key=lambda s: SEG_ORDER.get(s, 5))
        for seg in segs_here:
            seg_rows = hdf[hdf["Segment"] == seg].sort_values("Minutes", ascending=False)
            for _, r in seg_rows.iterrows():
                m = r["Minutes"]
                if m <= 0:
                    continue
                shade = shade_map.get((seg, r["Cluster"]), "#b2bec3")
                ax.bar(xi, m, bottom=bottom, width=0.72, color=shade, zorder=2,
                       edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.8)
                frac = m / 60.0
                if frac > 0.14:
                    txt = "%s\n%dmin" % (r["Cluster"], m)
                elif frac > 0.06:
                    txt = r["Cluster"]
                else:
                    txt = ""
                if txt:
                    ax.text(xi, bottom + m / 2.0, txt, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=22,
                            color="white", fontweight="600", zorder=3, linespacing=1.15)
                bottom += m

    ax.set_xlim(-0.6, n_hours - 0.4)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 60)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(hour_labels, fontsize=27)
    ax.set_yticks([0, 15, 30, 45, 60])
    ax.set_yticklabels(["0m", "15m", "30m", "45m", "60m"], fontsize=24)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#e8e8e8", zorder=0)
    for s in ["top", "right"]:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

    handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=shade) for _, _, shade, _ in legend_entries]
    labels = [name for _, name, _, _ in legend_entries]
    handles.append(plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color="#f0f1f5", ec="#dddddd"))
    labels.append("Running")
    ax.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.14),
              ncol=7, fontsize=22, frameon=False, handlelength=1.2, handleheight=1.2)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.035, right=0.99, top=0.98, bottom=0.22)

plt.show()
